title: BC Telemetry Buddy  – When Your 12-Year-Old Accidentally Helps You Find a Problem
summary: BC Telemetry Buddy is an MCP-based VS Code tool that lets you question Business Central telemetry in natural language instead of writing KQL. A casual demo question exposed a customer whose background queue codeunit ran slow full table scans on an unindexed queue table that lacked a retention policy. Diagnosis took about 15 minutes, and enabling retention plus adding an index removed the waste.
key_points: BC Telemetry Buddy uses AI over MCP so telemetry can be explored conversationally instead of through hand-written KQL.
It flagged a customer where the codeunit ISC Process Update Queue Meth caused most of the wasted processing time through full table scans on an unindexed, unpurged queue table.
Before the fix, about 19,946 slow queries ran each morning at 3.4 s on average; a month later only 18 ran in 7 days at 0.8 s, and Job Queue Dispatcher dropped below 25 minutes.
Investigations can be saved as markdown files in the workspace, which makes it easy to check later that a fix worked.

quotes.text: One question. One answer. Immediate diagnosis with lots of details!
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the core value proposition: BC Telemetry Buddy transforms hours of manual investigation into a single conversational query, dramatically reducing time investment for performance diagnostics.
